title: The down window gates every request of the lookup revalidation, not only a source's first page request
goal: The search host (api.github.com, export.arxiv.org, the Learn search), candidate pages, the made-up sibling and a pinned url's repository request read and record the host's down window as a source's own page does, so two searches against a host that does not accept a connection make one request, not two. Found by the SP-u5q37ds3 review (_tools/factdiff.py search_urls, page_doc, madeup_text; provider.repository_state).
notes: Merged from ST-ecxt66tw “A redirect target's connect failure does not put the redirecting host in its down window” at the 2026-10-13 draft triage: Premise holds by reading: detect_pass calls host_seen(url, error) with the source's own url (factdiff.py:1341), and provider.request keeps final=url when a redirect hop fails to connect, so the source's host gets the window. Rare: only 11 of 2621 sources redirect cross-host, none to a known-dead host. Same down-window paths and test file as ST-k445avpw. Its goal: When a source's url answers a redirect to another host that does not accept a connection, the down window is recorded for the target's host, not the source's own host that answered. Found by the SP-u5q37ds3 review (_tools/factdiff.py detect_pass and provider.request hops). Its checks: {"run": ["python3", "_tools/tests.py", "-k", "revalidate_down_window_redirect_target"]} Its touches: _tools/factdiff.py, _tools/provider.py, _tools/test_live_kb.py, kb/_self/tools.md
